title: WaterBridge Infrastructure LLC 8-K — Appointment of Director (Item 5.02)
summary: WaterBridge Infrastructure LLC (NYSE: WBI), a Houston-based midstream infrastructure company, filed a Form 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing the appointment of Valerie Chase as an independent director and Chair of the Audit Committee, effective April 13, 2026. Ms. Chase succeeds Kara Goodloe Harling as Audit Committee Chair and brings over 20 years of finance, accounting, and corporate governance experience, including prior roles at Apache Corporation and Magnolia Oil & Gas Corporation. Her compensation includes 2,830 RSUs vesting September 18, 2026, a $100,000 annual board retainer, and $20,000 additional annual retainers for Audit Committee service.
key_points: Valerie Chase appointed to WaterBridge Board as independent director on April 13, 2026, with term expiring at 2026 annual shareholder meeting.
Ms. Chase named Chair of Audit Committee, replacing Kara Goodloe Harling who remains on the Board.
Compensation: 2,830 RSUs (vesting Sept. 18, 2026), $100,000 annual board retainer, $10,000 Audit Committee retainer, $10,000 Audit Committee Chair retainer.
Prior experience: Head of accounting policy at Apache Corporation (2010-2018); Chief Accounting Officer and Controller at Magnolia Oil & Gas (2018-2021).
No disclosure-required relationships or transactions between Ms. Chase and the Company.
Signed by CFO Scott L. McNeely on April 14, 2026.
